spell.preamble: Spell out each word by putting a single space between every letter.

spell_inverse.preamble: Write each spelled-out word back as a normal word, without any spaces.

contains_char.preamble: Answer whether the given letter appears in the given word. Answer Yes or No.

contains_word.preamble: Answer whether the given word appears in the given sentence (case insensitive). Answer Yes or No.

orth.preamble: Pick which of the two candidate words is closer in spelling (Levenshtein edit distance) to the given word.

sem.preamble: Pick which of the two candidate words is more closely related in meaning to the given word.

ins_char.preamble: Insert the first letter immediately after every occurrence of the second letter in the given word.

ins_word.preamble: Insert the first word immediately after every occurrence of the second word in the given sentence.

del_char.preamble: Delete every occurrence of the given letter from the given word.

del_word.preamble: Delete every occurrence of the given word from the given sentence.

sub_char.preamble: Replace every occurrence of the first letter with the second letter in the given word.

sub_word.preamble: Replace every occurrence of the first word with the second word in the given sentence.

swap_char.preamble: Swap the positions of the two given letters in the given word.

swap_word.preamble: Swap the positions of the two given words in the given sentence.
